scp.scpmod.scp_173.desc: Moved to Site-19 in 1993; origin unknown. Constructed from concrete and rebar with traces of Krylon spray paint. SCP-173 is animate and extremely hostile; it cannot move while within a direct line of sight, which must not be broken at any moment. It attacks by snapping the neck at the base of the skull or by strangulation. When the containment chamber is empty, scraping sounds can be heard - considered normal.
scp.scpmod.scp_500.desc: Red pills in a small plastic container. One pill cures all diseases within two hours of oral ingestion, the exact time depending on the type and severity of the illness. All attempts to synthesize the active ingredient have failed.
scp.scpmod.scp_005.desc: An ornate key typical of mass-produced keys from the 1920s. It can easily open any form of lock, mechanical or digital. If a lock is well hidden or disguised, in about 50% of cases the user fails to recognize it as a lock and SCP-005 cannot open it - thus it is classified as 'sapient'.

screen.scpmod.motto.full:
Humanity has existed for 250,000 years, but only the last 4,000 of them have been meaningful. We Secure. We Contain. We Protect.

Mission Statement: Operating in the shadows around the world, the Foundation's goal is to contain anomalous objects, entities and phenomena. We maintain normalcy so that the rest of humanity can live in an ordinary, rational world.
screen.scpmod.manifest.title: MISSION STATEMENT
scp.scpmod.scp_006.desc:
Special Containment Procedures:
SCP-006 is a small spring. Its existence and properties must be kept secret. Personnel handling it physically must wear Class VI hazmat suits, and any direct skin contact triggers containment procedure 006-Xi-12 (considered a high-level biohazard leak). Any attempt to obtain a liquid sample requires the approval of three O5-level personnel.

Description:
SCP-006 is a small spring about 60 km west of Astrakhan. Ingesting its liquid produces the following effects: the ability to fully replicate DNA repair, significantly accelerated cell division, greatly improved tissue repair, and a massive increase in immune system efficiency. In animal tests, injected harmful bacteria and viruses were destroyed immediately. Most reptiles and birds are unaffected by the liquid, while higher primates show symptoms identical to humans.
